sharedSixBarEvidence.independentSource: AGENTS.md localStorage/bridge validation and secret privacy; README revocable sessions; packages/api agent-chat snapshot/fold version compatibility; documented cache policy and native IndexedDB schema; GUI authenticated resume and history-window contracts.
sharedSixBarEvidence.credibleFailures: Copied pending actions execute before host confirmation; cached content survives sign-out/removal/revocation; another daemon’s entries are touched; legacy/malformed records enter state; snapshot/cursor or omitted-agent identity disagree; stale saves overwrite newer data; LRU/capacity/cadence/open-timeout policy fails. Each case gives its exact condition.
sharedSixBarEvidence.independentOracle: Fixed legacy IndexedDB database/store/key/format bytes, authored frames/content/error/state, raw metadata corruption, controlled native IDB request failure/hang, literal cadence/size examples. No expectation reads the removed implementation helper or test-only override. FOLD_SNAPSHOT_VERSION is the separate public fold protocol used as an input version, never the cache owner’s oracle.
sharedSixBarEvidence.stableSeam: Production linkThreadCache/clearThreadCache over global indexedDB and localStorage; actual thread-store remount and app-store authentication actions. Raw fixture setup/inspection uses native-style IDB transactions and existing IDB dependency fake.
sharedSixBarEvidence.refactorResistance: No cache backend setter, factory parameter injection, helper export, map state injection or source grep. Fresh isolated page module instances preserve browser reload semantics without production reset hooks; externally persisted schema/keys and command receipts intentionally survive refactors.
sharedSixBarEvidence.uniqueProtection: Cache file owns storage validation, cadence and eviction; device-store file owns stream/reload/action confirmation; auth file owns wiring of sign-out/removal/401 into clearing. Explicit consolidation rows identify the surviving owner; no full workflow is added or replayed at an extra layer.

fixtureChanges: One existing fakeIndexedDb moved to testing/indexed-db.ts; duplicate memoryBackend implementations and auth keysBackend removed. Raw records use IDB requests. Existing fake gains request failure/gating, generic raw transaction fixture helpers and a pending/generation receipt that drains runnable native callbacks across an event-loop turn. Deliberately held requests count when released; no fixed settling rounds, sleeps, dependency or production injection.
validation: Four positive focused runs passed 49/49, zero failures/cancellations/skips; latest after removing threadCacheIdle passed in 5.203 s runner/5.25 s wall. Two frozen 923b baseline runs passed 55/55. Both intentional privacy/hang mutants failed direct intended assertions, and were repeated successfully against the final fixture receipt. Mutant scripts restore production source in finally. Scoped git diff --check passed; rg confirms no threadCacheIdle/setThreadCacheBackend/backendOverride references under packages/ui/src. Repository typechecks/full gates are coordinated by root.
